official_sources.title: GDAL gdalinfo exact min/max and approximate-statistics distinction
official_sources.finding: gdalinfo -mm forces actual band minimum and maximum computation, while -approx_stats may use overviews or a subset of tiles and is explicitly intended when precise statistics are not required.
official_sources.limitation: Actual min/max still depends on the correct immutable band, mask, NoData rules, scale/offset and parcel support.

official_sources.title: GDAL raster info all-pixel versus subset statistics
official_sources.finding: gdal raster info --stats uses all pixels, whereas --approx-stats uses a subset and may use overviews; the two modes are mutually exclusive.
official_sources.limitation: Dataset-wide all-pixel statistics do not replace parcel-mask-restricted extrema execution.

official_sources.title: GDALRasterBand exact statistics, cached metadata and clearing
official_sources.finding: ComputeStatistics can use overviews or tile subsets only when bApproxOK is true; GetStatistics may return cached STATISTICS metadata, and cached statistics can be cleared before a forced scan.
official_sources.limitation: A successful statistics call does not prove that cached values were generated from the current byte-identical source and validity mask unless provenance is checked.

official_sources.title: NumPy nanmin all-NaN and validity behavior
official_sources.finding: nanmin ignores NaNs but raises a RuntimeWarning and returns NaN for an all-NaN slice; where and initial controls alter the reduction support.
official_sources.limitation: NaN is only one invalidity representation and cannot replace authoritative mask, NoData and finite-value validation.

official_sources.title: NumPy argmin returns only the first tied minimum
official_sources.finding: argmin returns the index of the first occurrence when the minimum appears more than once.
official_sources.limitation: Using argmin alone silently discards other equally valid minimum cells and their provenance.

official_sources.title: NumPy argmax returns only the first tied maximum
official_sources.finding: argmax returns the index of the first occurrence when the maximum appears more than once.
official_sources.limitation: Using argmax alone silently discards other equally valid maximum cells and their provenance.

official_sources.title: NumPy nonzero deterministic C-order index enumeration
official_sources.finding: nonzero returns indices in row-major C-style order, providing a deterministic enumeration for an exact equality mask.
official_sources.limitation: The equality mask must be formed from validated native decoded values without hidden tolerance, rounding or broadcasting.

official_sources.title: NumPy isclose explicit and asymmetric tolerance semantics
official_sources.finding: isclose applies explicit absolute and relative tolerances relative to the second argument; default absolute tolerance can be inappropriate for small values and the comparison is not generally symmetric.
official_sources.limitation: Tolerance-based closeness must not redefine exact native raster equality or merge distinct extrema without an approved measurement-resolution policy.
